## Soil physicochemistry {#sec-ds-soil-physchem}

:::{.callout-warning title="work in progress"}
At the time of writing (09/2026), plans exist for the start of the soil monitoring schemes, but no concrete steps for data management have been taken.
:::

- Physical, Numerical.
- Physical samples will be held by INBO according to existing procedures.
- Adding new, project-specific data to an existing dataset (the INBOdem SQL Server database). Data are updated frequently (e.g. daily). Added data is verified.
- Expected to include 400 observations per year of around 15 measurement variables
- Collection expected to run from 2027 to 2050 and carried out exclusively by INBO.
- Backup strategy: monthly data dumps to cloud storage such as Google Drive, and to local digital storage (physical hard drives).
- Publishing strategy: planned to be published openly as soon as possible. Releases are made less frequently (e.g. yearly) to Zenodo.
- Data management responsibilities rest with INBO.
